cases.title: The four overdue buckets name exactly the invoices the list's own overdue filter names
cases.steps: GET /api/dashboard/outstanding-by-age, GET /api/invoices/summary and GET /api/invoices?filter=overdue:eq:true as the boundary-set Sales POC
cases.expected: sum of the 1–30 / 31–60 / 61–90 / Over 90 buckets = tiles.overdueAmount = 5.08 over 7 invoices, and the overdue-only list returns those same 7 rows (the two due today/tomorrow excluded)
cases.actual: buckets: 5.08 / 7; tiles.overdueAmount=5.08 overdueCount=7; overdue-only list totalElements=7

cases.title: A bucket window fetches the part-paid invoice behind it, and not the fully-paid or cancelled ones it excluded
cases.steps: GET /api/invoices?size=50&filter=status:in:UNPAID,PARTIALLY_PAID&filter=dueDate:between:2026-07-22,2026-08-20 as the Sales POC whose book holds one part-paid (12000.00 left), one fully-paid and one cancelled invoice all due 2026-07-22..2026-08-20
cases.expected: 1 row(s) totalling 12000, the part-paid invoice among them

cases.title: daysOverdue is exact at every boundary: 0 / 0 / 1 / 30 / 31 / 60 / 61 / 90 / 91
cases.steps: GET each of the nine boundary invoices by id and read overdue / daysOverdue
cases.expected: due today+1 and today → overdue=false, daysOverdue=0; the rest overdue=true with daysOverdue equal to the days since the due date
cases.actual: due+1 (2026-09-21) → overdue=false, daysOverdue=0; due+0 (2026-09-20) → overdue=false, daysOverdue=0; due-1 (2026-09-19) → overdue=true, daysOverdue=1; due-30 (2026-08-21) → overdue=true, daysOverdue=30; due-31 (2026-08-20) → overdue=true, daysOverdue=31; due-60 (2026-07-22) → overdue=true, daysOverdue=60; due-61 (2026-07-21) → overdue=true, daysOverdue=61; due-90 (2026-06-22) → overdue=true, daysOverdue=90; due-91 (2026-06-21) → overdue=true, daysOverdue=91
